t7_motbin_clips.provenance: T7 mot.bin decode 2026-10-24: asamot.bin (Asuka) decoded to wh-t7-motbin-json/1. Source JSONs are on game-reverse-engineering main at teardown/tekken7-steam/tkdata/mothead/json/asamot.json. Clip offsets resolved from the asamot.bin MotaList slot-0 MOTA and the asarotsm.arc section-0 MOTA (MOTA header: count at +12, offset list at +20, big-endian; every resolved clip verified to start 00 64 or 00 C8). Join key: anim_ref = bank + index into the bank MOTA offset list.
t7_motbin_clips.playable_wiring: NONE. No WH move in this file was given a mot.bin clip as its playable animation, and no existing anim_ref was changed. Reason: the display-title to internal-move join is NOT play-verified (frv/dnc decode report section 7: only 30 frv + 11 dnc titles walk deterministically, several collide on one landing move, and dnc walks land on the walk-forward state). Wiring those walks as playable animations would be guessing. This table wires clip KEYS only; a later lane may attach clips to WH moves only after play verification, one move at a time. The cancel_links below are mot-move-level file data (move Cancel lists), NOT playable WH string mappings: no WH move's string continuation was changed.

t7_motbin_clips.cancel_links_note: Button-press cancels only, verbatim from the mot.bin move Cancel lists. to_move_id_raw >= 32768 is an alias reference (0x8000 + slot), not a direct move index. Direction-only and empty-input cancels are NOT string-continuation presses and are excluded. Group cancels are NOT included: they need requirement condition-code resolution (same gap as the frv/dnc report section 7).
